Activate to read full description. About Nutanix     Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.     The Opportunity       At Nutanix, we're building the next generation of hybrid multicloud infrastructure with NC2 (Nutanix Cloud Clusters), enabling enterprises to seamlessly extend their datacenters to AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud. As a Senior Member of Technical Staff (SMTS) on the NC2 Engineering team, you'll work on large-scale distributed systems, cloud-native services, and automation platforms that power mission critical deployments for customers around the world.  This is an opportunity to solve challenging engineering problems spanning cloud infrastructure, networking, orchestration, scalability, reliability, and security. You'll take end-to-end ownership of features from architecture and design through implementation and production operations while collaborating with talented engineers, architects, and product leaders. If you're passionate about building highly scalable cloud platforms and want your work to directly influence the future of hybrid cloud, this role offers both technical depth and broad impact.   About the Team   The NC2 Engineering team is responsible for the core platform that orchestrates the lifecycle of Nutanix clusters across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud. We build the services that automate cluster provisioning, lifecycle management, networking, cloud integrations, monitoring, and operational workflows, enabling customers to manage their hybrid cloud environments with simplicity and confidence.  Our culture is built on engineering excellence, ownership, and collaboration. We value thoughtful design, clean architecture, operational excellence, and continuous learning. Engineers are empowered to drive technical decisions, mentor peers, and work across teams to deliver innovative solutions at scale. If you're excited by complex distributed systems, modern cloud technologies, and building products that thousands of enterprises rely on every day, we'd love to have you join us.   Responsibilities        Design, build, and evolve the core management plane that powers Nutanix Cloud Clusters (NC2), enabling seamless deployment, lifecycle management, and operations across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud   Architect and develop highly available, scalable, and fault-tolerant backend services for cluster provisioning, networking, lifecycle management, and cloud resource orchestration   Drive the design and implementation of cloud-native services with a strong focus on scalability, reliability, security, performance, and operational excellence   Lead technical design discussions and evaluate trade-offs in distributed systems, clustering, and large-scale service architectures.   Work closely with Product Management, Architecture, SRE, and engineering teams across geographies to deliver high-quality features with predictable execution.  Mentor engineers through technical leadership, architecture reviews, code reviews, and engineering best practices, while fostering a culture of ownership and continuous learning.   Take ownership of feature execution from design through deployment while maintaining a high-quality bar.     Required Skills        Strong experience designing and building scalable distributed systems and cloud-native backend services.   Hands-on expertise with one or more public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud), including cloud networking, compute, storage, and identity services.   Strong understanding of distributed systems concepts, including consistency, availability, fault tolerance, service orchestration, and resiliency patterns   Proven experience building and shipping production-grade backend services at scale.   Ability to independently drive projects with strong ownership and execution skills.   Excellent collaboration skills for working with globally distributed engineering teams.   Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to initiate, execute, and deliver complex features end-to-end.                    Qualifications & Experience     Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field.   A master's degree in computer science or a related discipline is preferred.   8+ years of software engineering experience building large-scale distributed systems, cloud platforms, or infrastructure software.   Hands-on experience with one or more public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud) and cloud-native technologies.     Preferred Programming Languages          Python   Go (Golang) We're an Equal Opportunity Employer    Nutanix is an Equal Employment Opportunity and (in the U.S.) an Affirmative Action employer.
